title: Microinjection molded PLA/ZnO-TiO2 composites with in situ fibrillation: achieving mechanical matching cortical bone and enhanced osteoinduction
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,25503-25514
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07812A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yong Xiang, Wenhao Song, Hui Yang, He Cai, Yijun Li, Tao Hu
ZnO nanoparticles were anchored to fibrous TiO2 substrates via hydrothermal deposition to minimize agglomeration. The incorporated ZnO markedly enhanced the bioactivity of the PLA-based devices, ultimately boosting their osteogenic capability.
